paragraphs.text: There are 96 plots on the site and 14 people on the waiting list. The water supply is turned on again on 1 April. The spring work party will be held on Saturday 22 March, starting at 9 am.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Plot rent rises to £38 this year. Members who bring a bag of their own compost to the work party receive a free packet of seeds. The shed key costs £4 and can be collected from the secretary on Sundays.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: There are 96 plots on the site and 14 people on the waiting list
items.prompt: How many plots are there on the site?

explanation.en: “96 plots on the site” → 96. 14 is the waiting list.
explanation.kk: «96 plots on the site» → 96. 14 — кезек. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.

items.quote: The water supply is turned on again on 1 April
items.prompt: When is the water turned on?

explanation.kk: «turned on again on 1 April» → 1 April. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
explanation.ru: «turned on again on 1 April» → 1 April. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.

items.quote: Plot rent rises to £38 this year
items.prompt: How much is the plot rent this year?

explanation.en: “rises to £38 this year” → £38. £4 is the shed key.
explanation.ru: «rises to £38 this year» → £38. £4 — ключ от сарая.

items.quote: can be collected from the secretary on Sundays
items.prompt: On which day can the shed key be collected?

explanation.en: “collected from the secretary on Sundays” → Sundays.
explanation.kk: «collected from the secretary on Sundays» → Sundays. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
explanation.ru: «collected from the secretary on Sundays» → Sundays. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
